name: Periodic table
description: All 118 elements, each asked eight ways, one subdeck per way: type the symbol, type the name, tap its cell on a blank table, name a lit-up cell, give its atomic number, period and group, its atomic mass, its family and block, and write its electron configuration. Every answer ends on the element's tile and its place in the coloured table, so the table builds itself in your head as you go. Uses the Element card type, which comes along. Data from PubChem.
author: Joao Henrique Costa Araujo

decks.name: Periodic table
decks.description: All 118 elements, eight ways each. Study one subdeck at a time, from **1 Symbols** down; every card ends on the element's place in the table, so the table builds itself as you go.

decks.name: Periodic table::1 Symbols
decks.description: See the name, type the symbol.

decks.name: Periodic table::2 Names
decks.description: See the symbol, type the name.

decks.name: Periodic table::3 Find it on the table
decks.description: See the name, tap its cell on a blank table.

decks.name: Periodic table::4 Name the cell
decks.description: A cell lights up on a blank table: which element is it?

decks.name: Periodic table::6 Atomic mass
decks.description: Its standard atomic weight, within half a unit.

decks.name: Periodic table::7 Family and block
decks.description: Alkali metal, halogen, lanthanide...; and s, p, d or f.

decks.name: Periodic table::8 Electron configuration
decks.description: Write the ground state, noble-gas shorthand allowed.

types.name: Element
types.description: One chemical element, asked one way: its symbol, its name, where it sits on the table, what sits in a highlighted cell, its numbers, its atomic mass, its family and block, or its electron configuration. Every answer ends on the element's tile and its place in the table.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: What the card asks: symbol, name, locate, identify, numbers, mass, family or config.

fields.name: mass
fields.description: Standard atomic weight, or the mass number of the most stable isotope.

fields.name: massText
fields.description: The mass as printed on the tile; [brackets] for elements with no stable isotope.

fields.name: massTolerance
fields.description: How far off a mass answer may be.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Empty for the lanthanides and actinides.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Accepted blocks (two for La, Lu, Ac, Lr, whose block is still argued).

fields.name: configAlt
fields.description: Other accepted configurations, where predictions disagree.

fields.name: predicted
fields.description: Configuration and family are predictions, not measurements.
